meta.title: Goal 3 lung cancer indicators by region (Finland)
meta.goal3_link: National Cancer Strategy 2026–2035, p. 5, Goal 3 (Varmistetaan yhdenvertainen ja vaikuttava syövänhoito): five-year relative survival of poor-prognosis cancers reaches the Nordic level (more than +14 percentage points for lung cancer from the 2023 NORDCAN level; Nordic level = mean of Sweden and Norway), and cancer mortality falls by 10% (currently 13,300 deaths a year).

regional_levels.mortality_and_incidence: Wellbeing services county (21 counties + City of Helsinki + Åland). Registry assigns deaths by home municipality in the year of death.
regional_levels.survival: Cooperation area (yhteistyöalue, 5 areas = former university-hospital catchment areas) + Åland. Not published by wellbeing services county.

meta.value_format: Each figure is {value, unit, source_id, year, is_estimate, note}; optional ci95_low/ci95_high, count, series. is_estimate=true marks our own derived or approximate figures.
meta.signal_rule: mortality_signal compares the region with the national age-standardised rate in both 2015–2019 and 2020–2024 using approximate 95% intervals. Only "consistently_higher" or "consistently_lower" should be presented as a finding.

sources.title: Suomen Syöpärekisteri, syöpätilastosovellus: Syöpien aiheuttamat kuolemat (kuolleisuus)
sources.table: Minua kiinnostaa = Syöpien aiheuttamat kuolemat; Sukupuoli = Molemmat yhdessä; Alue = all; Syöpätauti = Keuhkot, henkitorvi (C33-34); Näytä arvoja luokiteltuna = Aikajakso (5v.); Arvot = Syöpäkuolemia and Kuolleisuus per 100 000, ikävakioitu (Suomi 2014)
sources.note: Latest statistics year 2024 (app news 2026-04-24). Regional figures use home municipality in the year of death. Read from the app table in a browser; the app is a Shiny app without a stable deep link.

sources.title: Suomen Syöpärekisteri, syöpätilastosovellus: Uudet syöpätapaukset (ilmaantuvuus)
sources.table: Minua kiinnostaa = Uudet syöpätapaukset; Sukupuoli = Molemmat yhdessä (and Miehet/Naiset for the national split); Alue = all; Syöpätauti = Keuhkot, henkitorvi (C33-34); Aikajakso (5v.); Arvot = Todettuja syöpiä and Suhde per 100 000, ikävakioitu (Suomi 2014). Stage: Näytä arvoja luokiteltuna = Syövän levinneisyys (2020-2024), national only.

sources.title: Suomen Syöpärekisteri, syöpätilastosovellus: Syöpäpotilaiden ennusteet (eloonjääminen)
sources.table: Minua kiinnostaa = Syöpäpotilaiden ennusteet; Sukupuoli = Molemmat yhdessä; Alue = Koko maa + all yhteistyöalueet + Ahvenanmaa; Syöpätauti = Keuhkot, henkitorvi (C33-34); Näytä arvoja luokiteltuna = Vuosia toteamisesta (2022-2024); Arvo = Suhteellinen elossaololuku, ikävakioitu
sources.note: Regional survival is offered only by cooperation area (yhteistyöalue), not by wellbeing services county. The regional time series is not offered (the 3-year-period trend returns the national row only). No confidence intervals are shown.

sources.title: Tilastokeskus, kuolemansyyt, taulukko 13u5: Kuolleet ja yleinen kuolleisuusluku tilaston peruskuolemansyyn (aikasarjaluokitus) mukaan hyvinvointialueittain, 1969-2025
sources.table: API https://pxdata.stat.fi/PXWeb/api/v1/fi/StatFin/ksyyt/13u5.px; Hyvinvointialue = all; Kuolemansyy = 11 Kurkunpään, henkitorven ja keuhkon syöpä (C32-C34) and 04-21 Syövät (C00-C97); Vuosi = 2011-2025; Tiedot = Kuolleet, Yleinen kuolleisuusluku
sources.note: Table updated 2026-10-28. Includes laryngeal cancer (C32), so counts are slightly higher than the registry C33-C34 counts. Crude rate only; no age-standardised rate by region in this table.

sources.title: NORDCAN 2.0 (IARC / Association of the Nordic Cancer Registries): Survival – Trends, Lung (C33-C34)
sources.table: 5-year age-standardised relative survival (%), males and females, Finland/Norway/Sweden; API https://canapi.iarc.who.int/api/nordcan/v2/961//survival/population/5/1_2/246_578_752/160/?&surv_period=5&age_surv=0&year_start=1967&year_end=2024
sources.note: Data version 9.6.1 (11.2026). Survival is given by sex only. NORDCAN warns that Swedish survival for lung cancer may be too high because the Swedish registry does not follow back death-certificate-only cases.

sources.title: Team calculation from the sources above
sources.note: Means of published counts, approximate 95% intervals (Byar method on the total count, scaled to the age-standardised rate), signal flags, ratios and gaps. Marked is_estimate=true where approximate.

lung_cancer_cases_per_year.note: Mean of 5 years. Men 8901, women 6071 cases in 2020-2024. 2015-2019 total 14548.

mortality_incidence_ratio.note: Crude proxy only. Not a survival measure and not a Goal 3 indicator.

deaths_c32_c34_statfin_per_year.note: Latest year 2025: 2302 deaths. All cancer deaths (C00-C97) 2024: 13316, 2025: 13424; lung (C32-C34) was 17.1% of cancer deaths in 2025.

survival_relative_5y.note: Age-standardised relative survival, both sexes. 1-4 years: 45.97, 33.23, 26.66, 23.02%. Method (period vs cohort, standard weights) not stated in the app help.

survival_relative_5y_approx_halfwidth_pp.note: Rough: NORDCAN's national 95% CI half-width for Finnish men 2020-2024 (1.25 pp), taken to rest on the registry's 8901 male cases in 2020-2024, scaled by sqrt(cases) to 3349 cases (3/5 of the area's 2020-2024 cases, because the registry's survival window is 3 years).
